inputs.original_text: This is how the machinery works: a judge blocks a prolife law, and suddenly the story is no longer about protecting unborn lives but about institutions defending abortion under the banner of religious freedom. The ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice supplied the argument; the system’s framing makes the inversion look principled and any limit look oppressive. That doesn’t feel like an accidental shift in emphasis—it looks like a coordinated way to steer what people are allowed to see as the real issue.
